heading.001: SharedTrucks Logistics — Shared truckload across East Africa
meta.001: SharedTrucks connects East Africa’s SMEs with transport providers using technology-enabled shared truckload to make local products more affordable to move.
meta.003: Shared truckload for East Africa’s makers, growers and manufacturers. More affordable freight, better truck utilization and less wasted fuel.
copy.005: SharedTrucks helps East Africa’s farmers, makers and manufacturers share truck space and transport costs. We connect compatible shipments with available capacity so local goods can reach more customers.
access.003: Three separate groups of freight sharing the cargo space of a single truck
copy.007: Goods travelling on compatible routes and schedules can share a truck. Move your shipment without paying for a whole vehicle.
copy.008: Share transport costs with compatible loads and avoid paying for unused truck space.
copy.009: Put spare capacity to work on outbound and return journeys.
copy.010: Our technology brings routes, timing and available truck space together. Our team checks cargo compatibility and coordinates suitable transport providers.
copy.011: We review cargo compatibility and coordinate with suitable transport providers. The goal is to make existing journeys work harder while giving smaller businesses a dependable route to market.
copy.020: Vehicle and route updates help us plan each shipment.
copy.021: We match vehicle size and handling to your goods, from parcels to bulk freight.
